Context
-------
Read .github/copilot-instructions.md first. Then append the following
rules to it:

  - learner-vm scripts are ARTIFACTS. The agent never executes them on
    the target VM; there is no AI on the airgapped network. Execution
    evidence arrives only via feedback/airgap-run-*.md. Never claim a
    script "works" — claim it "validates and self-diagnoses".
  - Before any learner-vm change, read feedback/airgap-run-*.md (newest
    first) and the SCRIPT_VERSION comments in the scripts.
  - On every edit to a learner-vm script, bump its SCRIPT_VERSION and
    add a one-line comment describing the change.
  - Every learner-vm script must source scripts/lib.sh, be idempotent,
    support --dry-run, and emit the REPORT BEGIN/END block per the
    transcription protocol.

Objective
---------
Produce the foundation artifacts for the learner VM:
  scripts/lib.sh       shared helpers: logging, steps, report block
  scripts/00-diagnose.sh  read-only environment report
  lab-vm.conf          all configuration variables
  README-FIRST.md      the operator's run order and transcription guide

The target VM: RHEL 8.6, minimal base image, self-signed CA already in
the OS trust store, DNF via Artifactory (BaseOS, AppStream, EPEL,
Docker CE), fixed hostname, ISO attachable as a file or a CD-ROM
device. The script runs on this MINIMAL base — python3 may not be
useful, some tools may be absent. Every check must degrade to SKIPPED
with a reason rather than crash.

scripts/lib.sh
--------------
Provide:
  SCRIPT_NAME, SCRIPT_VERSION (each script sets these before sourcing)
  log()          [NN-name] prefix to stdout AND /var/log/lab-setup/
  step_ok "msg"  counts + logs ✓
  step_skip "reason" "msg"  counts + logs → SKIPPED
  step_fail "what" "fix-hint" ["diagnostic command"...]
    - counts the failure as F<n>
    - writes to the report: the failure, the fix-hint, and for each
      diagnostic command: runs it, includes up to 15 lines of output
      (indented), or the error if the command does not exist
  begin_report / end_report
    - end_report prints the REPORT BEGIN/END block: script name +
      version, hostname, UTC timestamp, repo git SHA (best effort),
      RESULT line (PASSED/FAILED with ok/failed/skipped counts), all
      F<n> entries, OK summary with full-log path, SKIPPED list, and a
      NEXT line supplied by the script
  run()          wrapper honouring --dry-run: prints "[dry-run] WOULD:
                 <cmd>" instead of executing
  require_or_skip "binary" "check description"
                 if the binary is absent, records a SKIPPED and
                 returns 1 so the caller can branch
  No ANSI colour inside the report block. Colour elsewhere is fine.
  Report block must stay under 60 lines: OK steps are summarised as a
  count; only failures, skips and diagnostics are itemised.

scripts/00-diagnose.sh
----------------------
Read-only. ALWAYS exits 0. No --dry-run needed (it changes nothing).
Checks, in order:
  1. System: /etc/redhat-release, uname -m, hostname, primary IPv4,
     memory, disk free on / and /var/lib
  2. ISO: ISO_PATH from lab-vm.conf — file or device?
     If file: loop-mount test to a temp dir, check BaseOS/ and
     AppStream/ exist, unmount. If device (/dev/cdrom or /dev/sr0):
     try mounting, same check, unmount. Report which form.
  3. Artifactory (curl, 10s timeouts, using the CA from the OS trust
     store — NOT --insecure):
       https://$ART_HOST/            (expect 200 or 302)
       manifest probes with Accept:
       application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json for:
         /library/busybox/manifests/1.36
         /fluent/fluent-bit/manifests/5.1.1
         /prometheus/node-exporter/manifests/v1.12.1
     On failure, auto-diagnostics: getent hosts $ART_HOST;
     curl -v tail (10 lines)
  4. Docker CE DNF candidates — fetch
     <candidate>/repodata/repomd.xml and report the HTTP status of
     each. Candidates (operator confirms the right one with the
     Artifactory admin):
       $DNF_DOCKER_CE_BASEURL (from lab-vm.conf)
       https://$ART_HOST/artifactory/docker-ce-rhel8/
       https://$ART_HOST/artifactory/docker-ce-centos8/
       https://$ART_HOST/docker-ce-rhel8/
  5. CA trust, three locations:
       /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/ — list files
       OS bundle contains the Artifactory CA (openssl + grep on the
       extracted subjects, best effort)
       /etc/docker/certs.d/$ART_HOST/ca.crt — expected absent
       /etc/containers/certs.d/$ART_HOST/ca.crt — expected absent
  6. Proxy env: HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, NO_PROXY (+ lowercase)
  7. DNF state: dnf repolist; dnf module list container-tools;
     dnf -q list available docker-ce (report whether it resolves; on
     failure include dnf -v output tail)
  8. Content: REPO_ROOT present? content/repos/<track> for all five
     tracks with lab*.html counts; content/docs/<track> landing pages
  9. Tools present: git, curl, podman, skopeo, docker, jq, java,
     python3 — with versions where present
 10. SELinux mode; firewalld state
Modes:
  (default) run all checks
  --selftest render a synthetic report block with 2 ok, 1 failed
             (with diagnostics), 1 skipped — proves the block renders.
             No system access. The agent runs this online.
Validation (agent-side, online):
  bash -n on all scripts; shellcheck with errors as failures and
  warnings allowed; run scripts/00-diagnose.sh --selftest and confirm
  the block renders within 60 lines and without colour codes.
  Report all three results.

lab-vm.conf
-----------
Template with defaults and a comment per variable:
  HOSTNAME="o11y-lab.internal"
  STATIC_IP=""            # empty = DHCP; set "192.168.10.10/24" if the
                          # Windows host must reach the VM. In-VM use
                          # does not need it.
  ART_HOST="artifactory.internal"
  ART_HOST_IP=""          # if set, 30-ca-and-trust.sh writes an
                          # /etc/hosts entry — removes DNS as a
                          # failure class during provisioning
  CA_CERT_SOURCE="/etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/airgap-ca.crt"
  ISO_PATH="/dev/cdrom"   # file path or device
  DNF_DOCKER_CE_BASEURL="https://artifactory.internal/artifactory/docker-ce-rhel8/"
  DNF_EPEL_BASEURL=""     # optional
  CONTENT_ROOT="<derived: repo root on the VM>"
  WORKSHOPS_ROOT="$CONTENT_ROOT/content/repos"
  DOCS_ROOT="$CONTENT_ROOT/content/docs"
  BROWSER="firefox"

README-FIRST.md
---------------
One page: what this repo is; transfer to VM; the run order
(00 → 10-50 → 60 → 70 → 80 → snapshot); the transcription protocol
with one example block; the rule "transcribe, don't improvise"; how to
record feedback/airgap-run-00N.md on the online side.

Acceptance
----------
1. bash -n and shellcheck pass on all new scripts.
2. 00-diagnose.sh --selftest output pasted — block renders, ≤60 lines,
   no colour codes, has F1 with diagnostics and one SKIPPED.
3. lab-vm.conf and README-FIRST.md pasted for review.
